// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/profile-writes-single-path.test.ts.
// Calls applyFactWrites — and then writes the RAW patch, discarding what it
// decided. The precedence rule ran and changed nothing. The guard must flag
// this as `result_discarded`, not accept the call as proof.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { applyFactWrites, existingFacts, factWritesFrom, profileFactData } from "@/lib/services/protection-profile/fact-writes"

export async function probeDiscardedResult(userId: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const existing = await db.policyholderProfile.findUnique({ where: { userId } })
    const facts = profileFactData(
        applyFactWrites({
            existing: existingFacts(existing as Record<string, unknown> | null),
            writes: factWritesFrom(patch, { source: "assessment", precision: "exact" }),
            now: new Date(),
        })
    )
    void facts
    await db.policyholderProfile.upsert({
        where: { userId },
        update: { ...patch },
        create: { userId, ...patch },
    })
}
